title: Works
summary: Docs, decks and sheets with review and export gates. Create, edit and review on the host; export receipts only for approved revisions.

listing.tagline: Docs, decks and sheets with review and export gates
listing.about: Works keeps docs, decks and sheets as revisioned host content. An author edits and requests review; an independent reviewer approves or requests changes; an export receipt is recorded only for the approved current revision. The app does not approve its own content.
can: Draft and edit docs, decks and sheets with typed content
Request review and see pending, reviewed and edited state
Trash and restore content without losing its revision
Export only an approved current revision, as a receipt
